parameters.name: FileCategoryCode
parameters.description: The code of the file category.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset instance to which the OSS object belongs.

> To query the list of authorized OSS objects by the ID of the asset instance, call the **DescribeInstances** operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: LastScanTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the last scan. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: LastScanTimeStart
parameters.description: The start time of the last scan. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Marker
parameters.description: The position where the query starts. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the value of `NextMarker` from the previous response.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: RiskLevelId
parameters.description:
The risk level ID of the OSS object. Valid values:

- **1**: N/A. No sensitive data is detected.

- **2**: S1. Level 1 sensitive data.

- **3**: S2. Level 2 sensitive data.

- **4**: S3. Level 3 sensitive data.

- **5**: S4. Level 4 sensitive data.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the OSS object matches.

> To query the list of authorized OSS objects by the ID of a matched sensitive data detection rule, call the **DescribeRules** operation to obtain the rule ID.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the industry-specific template.
